event.title: Mockingbird Jam 2026
event.subtitle: A full day of music, community, and fundraising to support ALS research and local families navigating ALS.

hero.headline: Music, movement, and community support for ALS families
hero.subhead: Spend the day with yoga, church, live music, food trucks, a silent auction, and all-day fundraising that helps ALS research and families living with ALS.

event.post_event_message: Mockingbird Jam 2026 has wrapped. Thank you for showing up for the music, the auction, and the ALS mission.
event.auction_hidden_message: Auction items are not public yet. Check back soon for the full silent auction lineup.
event.auction_status_note: Bid submissions are reviewed manually and confirmed by email or phone.

als_mission.title: Supporting ALS research and ALS families
als_mission.body: Mockingbird Jam raises funds for ALS research while also helping families facing the day-to-day impact of ALS. Every bid, sponsorship, and donation helps extend that support.
